dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly concave trailing edge exhibiting a deep falcate spline; curvature is most pronounced in the middle third of the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a small pixel radius at the termination of the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Initial shallow angle at the anterior insertion point transitioning to a steeper convex curve of approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible base length along the dorsal ridge is approximately 2.3 times the maximum vertical height to the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white punctate marks and small depigmented patches are visible across the lateral surface of the dorsal fin and the adjacent back.
other_distinctive_markers: The fin exhibits an extremely narrow distal portion below the apex, creating a sharp hook-like profile.
